    Beauty Club rules & privacy

    Joining is optional. Stamps are added by salon staff after a service is completed and paid. Booking an appointment does not earn a stamp. One stamp is awarded per visit, regardless of the number of treatments.

    Rewards are personal and have no cash value. Tell the team before paying when you wish to use a reward. Complimentary treatments are selected with the salon. Staff check availability and record each redemption.

    Your verified email, name, selected language, stamps and reward history are stored securely in Firebase. Progress and reward emails are part of the programme. Promotional emails require separate, optional consent. For membership or privacy enquiries, contact kannika54932@gmail.com.
